CORRECTION TO ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISCORRECTIONTOZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT (this “Agreement") is made as of the 14th day of April, 2025 by SM 84TH TIC 1501, LLC, a New York limited liability company ("SM"), FSM HOLDINGS II 1501, LLC, a New York limited liability company ("FSM"), and DMZ III 1501, LLC, a New York limited liability company ("DMZ",and together with SM and FSM,as tenants-in-common, referred to herein collectively as “Owner"), each having an address c/o SMA Equities, LLC, 185 Great Neck Road, Suite 250, Great Neck, New York 11021 (Owner in its capacity as the owner of the Lower Parcel, as hereinafter defined, (*Lower Parcel Owner”), and in its capacity as the owner of the Airspace Parcel, as hereinafter defined, (*"Airspace Parcel Owner")). STATEMENTOFFACTS Owner is the owner in fee of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon,in the County of NewYork,City and State of NewYork,generallyknown by the street address 1501 Third Avenue,NewYork,NewYork,designated as Lot 47in Block 1530 on the described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the "OwnerParcel"). Owner previously entered into a Zoning Lot Development Agreement dated as of February 3, 2025 and recorded in the Office of the Register for New York County on March 6, 2025 at CRFN 2025000063025 (the“Existing ZLDA") in connection with the creation of the Lower Parcel and the AirspaceParcel, as defined therein. The definition of Lower Limiting Plane in the Existing ZLDA refers to an elevation of 174.42 feet above Datum Level. Owner intended the definition of Lower Limiting Plane in the Existing ZLDA to refer to an elevation of 145.27 feet above Datum Level, consistent with the metesandboundsdescriptionsfor theLowerParcelandtheAirspaceParcelattachedtothe Existing ZLDA. Owner desires to correct this error in the Existing ZLDA. NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained in this Agreement and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged,the parties hereto covenant and agree asfollows: in the Existing ZLDA shall have the meanings given in the Existing ZLDA. 2. Lower Limiting Plane. Section 1.10 “Lower Limiting Plane” of the Existing ZLDA is hereby deleted in its entirety and replaced as follows: Section 1.10. “Lower Limiting Plane” means that certain horizontal plane located at an elevation of 145.27 feet above Datum Level and having an area coincident withtheboundariesoftheOwnerParcelasdescribedonExhibitAannexedhereto.
